newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Steel may study Chinese mine feasibility.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Steel may study Chinese mine feasibility.

text.p: U.S. Steel may study the feasibility of an investment in an iron mine in southwestern China, spokesman Tom Ferrall said Monday.

Responding to questions about a Xinhua news agency report Saturday that the company will invest in a $30 million venture to mine for ore, he said the company's USX Engineers and Consultants Inc subsidiary signed a protocol last week that "may lead to a feasibility study with Kunmin (Iron and Steel Corp) on this issue."
UEC has Canadian based subsidiary that could get involved in the study, Ferrall said.
If a decision is made to proceed with the study, he continued, the company will make an investment in the thousands of dollars.
U.S. Steel is a subsidiary of USX Corp.
